name: Ezra Thayre
role: Early convert and missionary from New York
dateNote: He was baptized in fall 1830; section 33 dates from October 1830 and section 56 from June 1831.
importance: Section 33 calls him and Northrop Sweet to preach soon after their baptism. Section 52 sends him to Missouri with Thomas B. Marsh. Section 56 cancels that mission because he was not ready and tells him to repent of pride and selfishness. Section 75 pairs him with Marsh again in January 1832.
connections: Parley P. Pratt baptized him. His named companions are Northrop Sweet and Thomas B. Marsh.

sources.title: Ezra Thayre, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP (listed as Ezra Thayer): born 14 Oct. 1791, New York; baptized fall 1830; high priest 4 June 1831; Camp of Israel 1834; Adam-ondi-Ahman high council 1838; Council of Fifty 1844; later with Strang, rebaptized 1854, joined the Reorganized Church 1860. Death in Cass County, Michigan; date only a fragment (6 Sept. 1862). Bare “Ezra” left out because it also names Ezra Booth and Ezra T. Benson.
